item.title: Version 1.7.0
item.description:
SupaSidebar 1.7.0

SupaSidebar 1.7.0 adds browser keys for ⌘T, ⌘N and ⌘L, a lighter Command Panel in your Space’s color, and simpler Settings.

What’s New

  • Browser Keys Page - Turn ⌘T, ⌘N, ⌘L and ⌃Tab on separately in Settings > Browsers > Browser keys.
  • Edit the Address With ⌘L - Turn on ⌘L to edit the page’s address in the Command Panel, and Return loads it in the same tab.
  • Command Panel in Your Space Color - The Command Panel takes your current Space’s color, with a Tint with Space color switch to turn it off.
  • Live Tabs in One List - A new Live Tabs setting shows all your open tabs in one list, without browser and window headers.
  • Browser Setup in Onboarding - New users can pick their browsers, turn on browser keys and try SupaView for links during setup.

Improvements

  • A Lighter Command Panel - One-line rows now show six results at a time, under a bigger search field.
  • Edit a Result Before Opening It - Pressing ↓ puts the selected result’s address in the search field, ready to edit, like Chrome.
  • Web Suggestions Among Your Results - Google suggestions and past searches now sit with your other results instead of in a separate area.
  • Tab Into History or a Site - Type a word like “hist” or “reddit” and press Tab to search History or that site.
  • Recent Is Now History - The Recent scope is renamed History, and the scope bar stays hidden until you press Tab.
  • Your Top Settings in an Empty Panel - With nothing typed, the panel lists your 5 most-used settings and Talk to Founder instead of every command.
  • Footer Keys Match the Selected Row - The footer now shows what ↩︎, SupaView and Open with do for the row you’re on.
  • One Row per Site - Typing a site’s name now shows a single row for it, and repeated History visits show once.
  • ⌘N Opens a New Window - Pages and searches picked after ⌘N now open in a new browser window instead of a new tab.
  • Simpler Settings - Settings now has a Browsers section and fewer pages, with Mouse Triggers under Sidebar and Backups under Data.
  • Choose Which Browsers to Use - The browser table’s Block column is now Use, so you tick the browsers SupaSidebar works with.

Bug Fixes

  • The Tab Switcher now shows a site’s icon instead of stretching square logos like LinkedIn’s or Instagram’s.
  • Tab Switcher previews that failed while offline now load again once you’re back online, without a restart.
  • The Tab Switcher now lists your recent tabs right after launch, even before you open the sidebar.
  • Labs, Archived Tabs, Tab Switcher and SupaView sign-in screens now show in your language instead of English.

Performance

  • Faster Command Panel Typing - Keys no longer pile up while you type, a lag that could reach 1.5 seconds before.
  • No Pause on the First ⌘ Key - The first ⌘ shortcut you press in the Command Panel after launch no longer stalls.

item.title: Version 1.1.0-beta.2
item.description:
SupaSidebar 1.1.0-beta.2

What’s New

  • Updated Onboarding: New setups now use a browser-aware flow that helps you choose useful sites, configure how SupaSidebar opens, and reach your first working sidebar faster.
  • Search Settings: Find preferences from one search field, jump directly to the right section, and change supported toggles from the results.
  • Scoped Search Shortcuts: Assign optional shortcuts that open the Command Panel directly in the Live Tabs or Saved scope.
  • Precise Auto-Close Duration: Choose a custom timeout using any combination of days, hours, and minutes.
  • Local Folder Preview Sorting: Order files and subfolders by Name A-Z, Name Z-A, Date Modified Newest, or Date Modified Oldest. Name sorting handles numbered files naturally, so Export 2 appears before Export 10.

Improvements

  • Smart Attach Stays in Sync: The menu and Preferences now agree with the sidebar’s actual attachment mode.
  • Sidebar Size and Position Are Remembered: A sidebar you move or resize returns to the same position and height after relaunching SupaSidebar.
  • Auto-Show Is Opt-In for New Setups: The sidebar does not appear automatically when you focus a browser unless you enable Auto Show on Browser Focus.
  • Command Panel shortcut hints now adapt better when the panel has limited space.

Bug Fixes

  • Live Tabs search no longer hides an open tab when the same URL is also saved in SupaSidebar.
  • Dragging a link or folder into a folder no longer moves the entire sidebar window.

Notes

  • Local Folder Preview Sorting applies to Finder-style folder preview columns. It does not rearrange your saved SupaSidebar folders.
